caption: The drawing depicts a statue-like figure of a woman dressed in a long, flowing gown with elaborate folds and decorative patterns. The gown is primarily white or light gray, with gold or brownish-yellow highlights outlining the edges, patterns, and accessories. The woman stands on a rectangular base, and her hair is styled back with a headband that matches the gown's accent color. In her left hand, she holds a wide-brimmed hat with a ribbon, similar in color to the gown's highlights. Her right hand grasps the handle of a single long wooden oar, which is colored brown, contrasting with the rest of the sculpture. The background is plain, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Figurehead
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
